info.title: Bazario API
info.description: Public API for the Bazario marketplace web app.

patch.summary: Suspend, reactivate or change the role of a user

post.summary: Log in with email and password
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair

put.summary: Add a product or set its quantity

delete.summary: Remove a product from the cart

get.summary: A category with its breadcrumb and subcategories

post.summary: Price the current cart and start a checkout session
Pay for a quote and place the order

get.summary: Number of unread notifications (polled by the header badge)

post.summary: Cancel an order that has not shipped yet

201.description: Review created (may be held for moderation)

post.summary: Apply to become a seller (reviewed by an admin)
Set stock for many products at once

404.description: A product does not exist or is not yours

get.summary: Recent stock changes for a product

put.summary: Add a product to your wishlist

delete.summary: Remove a product from your wishlist
